limitations: OMR is fan-authored; source model omissions are not a guarantee of retail inventory completeness. Models flagged for missing parts or prints remain partial until reviewed.
Unsupported compound accessories, asymmetric limbs and attachment orientations are reported rather than guessed.
Rebrickable optional API imports require a build-time key and verified external part/color mappings. No key is needed to build or browse the checked-in catalog.
